parts.title: How the pieces fit
parts.body: Traditional supervised learning trains a model on examples with target labels. A foundation model learns broad patterns during pretraining, then may be adapted through instruction tuning or other techniques. A transformer uses attention to relate tokens in context. At inference time it predicts a continuation, which can be useful without guaranteeing truth. Multimodal systems extend the input or output beyond text. Ask which capability is actually required by the workflow before choosing a model.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Choose a fit test
parts.body: For invoice classification, compare a conventional classifier, rules, and a general language model on the same labeled cases. Record accuracy by document type, review effort, latency, and cost per invoice. A demo on five clean invoices tells little about blurred scans or unusual suppliers.
